verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage markets in-product AI agents for customer screening, ongoing monitoring and transaction monitoring. These agents auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate high-risk or complex cases for human review, which implies AI-driven assessment of the user's own data. The evidence shows the AI acting on alerts, not surfacing insights or suggestions to the user, and comes only from thin marketing-page mentions. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights or recommendations shown to users (e.g., alert summaries, suggested decisions, rationale), detailed first-party docs on how the agents present their output, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
